English:
General Guba's caused me a lot of grief on this godforsaken island. Now it's payback time.

Better stay sharp, though - don't want to lose it now, having come so far. Scouts report there are plenty of hardcore troops still loyal to Guba in the North, and they may even have tanks.

And I also suspect the good General's got trick or two still up his sleeve.

At least I've got a few vehicles of my own here in the base, a strong team, and a good supply of grenades...
Red Dawn
Arrest General Guba before he leaves the island.
Be sure to deal with any last-minute surprises from Guba.
Get back.

NATO has conquered the South part of Kolgujev, and we've destroyed Guba's nuclear missile. Soviet troops are plunged into chaos, and they're retreating to the North. All we need to do now is pick up the General.

Intel reports that Guba left his residence in a jeep with Colonel Eusev just couple of minutes ago. He'll probably will try to leave the island in a boat, because NATO now controls all airspace around Kolgujev. Find him and arrest him before he can leave.

Commander Gastovski, you'll start here with your squad.
